title: Human
body: You: reads the plan, answers the quiz, decides.

title: Master session
body: The coordinating OpenCode session: owns the plan, assigns work, runs compile and the quiz.

title: Worker or subagent
body: A building session (w1..w5) or a background subagent the master starts.

title: Handoff plugin
body: The OpenCode plugin (plugins/handoff): handoff instead of compaction, journal flushes, the index in every prompt.

title: Store server and CLI
body: coordlite: one MCP server process per session (tools), and the CLI the plugin shells out to.

title: SQLite store
body: One WAL-mode file shared by every session; every multi-statement write runs inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
